note.cycle: *33% off power bills in the long run and over 4× the energy efficiency of a conventional system, that is an AC plus a conventional electric water heater; data from Topband's HVAC test lab.
note.standardSave: *Up to ¥6,000 saved a year: data from Topband's HVAC test lab.
note.iplv: *Weighted combined heating and cooling efficiency of 5.6: the ORVIBO Integrated HVAC W1's year-round cooling efficiency is 4.43; test data show that heat recovery adds about 1.2 to the combined efficiency, which so reaches 5.6.
note.water: *8× the efficiency: costs assume electricity at ¥0.9 per kWh and gas at ¥3.5 per m³, with the ORVIBO Integrated HVAC W1 cooling for 5 months a year and recovering its waste heat. The 800% thermal efficiency is the highest weighted year-round efficiency, reached when the AC cools through the 5 summer months and its waste heat keeps making hot water.
note.floor: *Floor heating saves up to 50%: total cost over 3 winter months for 120 m² of floor heating, against a grade 2 efficiency boiler's figures under GB 20665-2015.

eco.title: Greener
eco.heading: Driving carbon neutrality and sustainable smart new energy
eco.text:
ORVIBO Integrated HVAC uses heat pump technology to draw endless clean energy from the air,
reinventing air conditioning, floor heating and hot water at home, to end our dependence on
fossil fuels and harm the planet less, speeding up smart homes toward a more sustainable future.

note.tenYear: *10-year warranty: the main unit (excluding parts) has a 10-year warranty, that is the standard 6 years plus a free 4-year extension, given only on orders placed during the promotion.
